'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Shaw LS Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Luke Is NPE
* '''Username:''' stealtheblind
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
